_meta.note: Derived file - regenerated from the HPI-CT workbooks (source of truth). Do not hand-edit. Public-source, personal-capacity work; all case figures reflect allegations/settlements as described in cited public documents, not findings of fact unless a court so determined.

data_sources.name: OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE)
data_sources.contents: All individuals/entities excluded from federal healthcare programs
data_sources.how_to_get: Monthly CSV download + online search API
data_sources.caveats: Name matching needs fuzzy logic; verify hits against full record before action

data_sources.name: SAM.gov Exclusions (formerly EPLS)
data_sources.caveats: Broader than healthcare; classification codes matter

data_sources.name: SSA Death Master File (DMF)
data_sources.how_to_get: NTIS certification + subscription; states often have direct SSA matches
data_sources.caveats: Full file restricted since 2011; state vital-records matches supplement; false positives on common names

data_sources.name: State DOC + county jail rosters ("jail feeds")
data_sources.access_tier: MIXED (public rosters to formal data-sharing agreements)
data_sources.how_to_get: State DOC offender search/bulk files; county integrations vary; some states run centralized justice-data matches
data_sources.caveats: County coverage is the weak spot - prioritize state DOC + largest counties; CAA 2024 suspend-not-terminate (eff. 1/1/2026) makes this match load-bearing
data_sources.link: state DOC sites / justice data-sharing MOUs

data_sources.name: PARIS (Public Assistance Reporting Information System)
data_sources.contents: Interstate matches of public-assistance enrollment (incl. Medicaid) + VA/federal payroll files
data_sources.how_to_get: State PARIS participation via ACF; quarterly match files
data_sources.caveats: State-agency only; quarterly lag; match resolution workflow is on you

data_sources.name: NPPES (NPI Registry)
data_sources.contents: All NPIs with provider demographics, taxonomy, addresses
data_sources.how_to_get: Full monthly file + weekly updates + API
data_sources.caveats: Self-reported fields go stale; addresses lag reality

data_sources.name: Medicare Order & Referring / PECOS enrollment files
data_sources.contents: Providers eligible to order/refer; enrollment status
data_sources.caveats: Medicare-scope; state Medicaid enrollment is separate

data_sources.name: CMS Preclusion List
data_sources.contents: Providers precluded from MA/Part D payment
data_sources.how_to_get: Distributed to MA/Part D plans via HPMS

data_sources.name: CMS Open Payments
data_sources.contents: Industry payments to physicians/teaching hospitals (COI/kickback indicator)
consumed_by: C-06 kickback/COI screen of referral relationships
data_sources.caveats: Disclosure data, not wrongdoing; use as risk indicator only

data_sources.name: NCCI PTP edits + MUE files
data_sources.caveats: Version discipline matters (currently v322r0 eff. 7/1/2026 per update monitor); Medicaid NCCI differs slightly

data_sources.name: DMEPOS Master List + Required Prior Authorization List
data_sources.caveats: Effective dates matter; last known update eff. 4/13/2026 (+18 codes)

data_sources.name: Medicare utilization PUFs (provider/service level)
data_sources.contents: Aggregate billing by provider/service for peer benchmarking
data_sources.caveats: 1-2 year lag; aggregate only - directional benchmarks, not cases

data_sources.name: T-MSIS / TAF research files
data_sources.how_to_get: ResDAC application (research); states have own MMIS data
consumed_by: PI-20/21/22/23 program-integrity analytics, MD-24 self-directed, MD-26 NEMT (v1.2 ID-link)
data_sources.caveats: Heavy access process; states should use their own MMIS first

data_sources.name: State PDMP (prescription drug monitoring)
data_sources.how_to_get: Prescriber/pharmacy/plan access per state law; PMP InterConnect for interstate
data_sources.caveats: Access rules vary sharply by state and role

data_sources.name: EVV system data (21st Century Cures mandate)
data_sources.contents: Electronic visit verification: who/what/when/where for personal care + home health
data_sources.match_keys: Visit ID, attendant ID, member ID, GPS/time
consumed_by: MD-24 self-directed EVV, MD-26 NEMT trip data (v1.2 ID-link)
data_sources.caveats: Verifies the ATTENDANT, not the recipient status - pair with DS-03/DS-04 matches (Missouri lesson)

data_sources.name: State SOS business registries + ownership-disclosure sources (CMS/state disclosure, SAM.gov entity, PECOS)
data_sources.custodian: State Secretaries of State; SAM.gov (Entity); CMS/state ownership-disclosure filings; PECOS  [FinCEN BOI RETIRED 2026-08-14]
data_sources.contents: Entity officers, registered agents, formation dates, addresses
data_sources.how_to_get: SOS searches/bulk (varies); SAM.gov entity search/extract; CMS 42 CFR 455.104/.105/.106 + 424.519 & state ownership-disclosure filings; PECOS enrollment record; LEIE/SAM cross-match. (FinCEN BOI RETIRED 2026-08-14 - final rule FR 2026-16576 ended BOI reporting for U.S.-formed entities; no longer available as a corroboration source.)
consumed_by: PI-21/22/23 entity-network & ownership, MD-24 relationship overlap (v1.2 ID-link)
data_sources.caveats: Cross-state assembly is manual; shared address/agent is signal not proof. FinCEN BOI RETIRED 2026-08-14 (FR 2026-16576) - no longer an independent corroboration source; ownership corroboration re-pointed to CMS/state ownership-disclosure filings (primary), SAM.gov entity, state SOS registries, and PECOS/424.519. Evidence ceiling (Rule 12): self-reported ownership disclosure = push-provenance ceiling 2 unless registry-cross-matched (then 3).
data_sources.link: state SOS sites; sam.gov; pecos.cms.hhs.gov; ecfr.gov/current/title-42/section-455.104

data_sources.name: Provider revocation/termination lists (Medicare revocations; state Medicaid terminations)
data_sources.how_to_get: CMS lists; state Medicaid termination files; cross-state sharing via T-MSIS/portals
data_sources.caveats: 42 CFR 455.416 requires state action on other-state terminations

data_sources.name: DOJ/OIG/GAO enforcement + oversight feeds
data_sources.how_to_get: Automated daily harvest (this project) via PIA Connect MCP + web
consumed_by: Feeds Control-Failure Learnings + Diagnosis Matrix priorities - the "model learning" loop
data_sources.caveats: Allegations until adjudicated; the more cases coded, the sharper the priorities
